correctness.rationale: The finite field is explicitly defined and the 21 projective points and lines are reconstructed. Exhaustive checking of all subsets of sizes one through seven gives face counts 21,210,1120,2520,1008,168,0. The complete 5047-element nonempty face poset has a 2148-pair matching leaving one vertex and 750 three-cells. All 19908 codimension-one incidences are oriented and the entire directed graph is topologically sorted, proving acyclicity. Forman discrete Morse theory therefore yields exactly the claimed sphere wedge. The checker was executed successfully with distinct hash seeds; Euler characteristic -749 is consistent.

value.rationale: The projective order-four plane is the first nontrivial even-order plane beyond the seven-point Fano plane, with 168 genuine six-point hyperovals. Determining the full homotopy type of its complex of all caps—not simply enumerating large caps—produces an exact torsion-free topological invariant and a reusable finite acyclic-matching certificate. The result is a natural self-contained classification motivated by finite-geometry cap and coding literature.
